description: List everything currently IN FLIGHT across the wallet's four durable stores: pending Pix withdrawals, in-flight Boltz swaps (Lightning send/receive and stablecoin), the tracked SideSwap peg-in, and non-terminal SideShift shifts. Each item carries rail, id, state and rail-specific fields. Read-only and local (no network, no signing) — use wallet_recover to re-drive these items. Moves no money.
name: wallet_pending

pending.description: Everything currently in flight across the four durable stores, newest data as stored. Empty when nothing is pending.

current_leg.description: plan only: 1-based leg currently being driven.

hops.description: plan only: total legs in the route.

id.description: Rail-scoped id: withdrawal Idempotency-Key, Boltz swap id, SideSwap peg order id, SideShift shift id, or conversion plan id.

key_mode.description: withdrawal only: the key mode that created it. A requested record is resumed only while that same mode is active — under the other mode it is held, not lost.

network.description: sideshift only: the non-Liquid network of the shift.

note.description: Manual instruction for an item recovery will not advance: a plan parked needs_review, or a boltz swap parked unrecoverable (no refund key on record).

peg_addr.description: pegin only: the BTC address the owner funds externally.

rail.description: Which rail the item is in flight on ('plan' = a multi-hop conversion plan chaining the others).

recv_addr.description: pegin only: OUR Liquid address SideSwap pays L-BTC to.

route_id.description: plan only: the multi-hop route being executed (its id lists every leg).

state.description: Rail-specific state/status string (e.g. requested/signed, locked_up, pending, waiting).

swap_type.description: boltz only: which swap kind is in flight.

txid.description: withdrawal only: broadcast Liquid txid, when known.

withdrawal_id.description: withdrawal only: provider withdrawal id, when known.

title: List everything in flight
